тропічний.label: Tropical
тропічний.desc: Likes 18–26 °C and 50–70% humidity. Avoid drafts and sudden temperature swings.

декор.label: Decor
декор.desc: A bold accent in the living room or office — large leaves or striking silhouette.

очищення повітря.label: Air purifying
очищення повітря.desc: NASA studies list it among plants that reduce formaldehyde and other VOCs indoors.

ампельний.label: Trailing
ампельний.desc: Stems cascade — perfect for hanging planters or high shelves.

для початківців.label: Beginner-friendly
для початківців.desc: Forgives irregular watering and beginner mistakes — great first plant.

тіньолюбний.label: Low-light tolerant
тіньолюбний.desc: Grows well away from the window or on a north-facing side.

мінімалізм.label: Minimalist
мінімалізм.desc: Clean shape, low maintenance — fits modern interiors.

спальня.label: Bedroom
спальня.desc: No bright light needed; some species release oxygen at night.

нічний кисень.label: Night oxygen
нічний кисень.desc: CAM photosynthesis at night — a natural bedroom air freshener.

преміум.label: Premium
преміум.desc: Large specimen in a designer pot with an extended Root & Leaf guide.

вітальня.label: Living room
вітальня.desc: Central focal point visible from anywhere in the room.

великий лист.label: Large leaves
великий лист.desc: Leaves 30 cm+ — instant jungle vibe and space filler.

офіс.label: Office
офіс.desc: Tolerates AC and weaker open-plan lighting.

тінь.label: Shade
тінь.desc: Happy a few metres from the window without direct sun.

глянець.label: Glossy foliage
глянець.desc: Shiny leaves — wipe dust every 2–3 weeks for best shine.

квітка.label: Flowering
квітка.desc: Blooms with enough light and humidity — white spaths or bright buds.

очищення.label: Purifying
очищення.desc: Removes airborne pollutants — good for bedroom and nursery.

ванна.label: Bathroom
ванна.desc: Loves post-shower humidity — often no humidifier needed.

дерево.label: Tree form
дерево.desc: Develops a trunk and canopy — may need a stake while growing.

темне листя.label: Dark foliage
темне листя.desc: Deep green or burgundy tones — contrasts light walls.

сукулент.label: Succulent
сукулент.desc: Stores water in leaves — water rarely, drainage is essential.

кухня.label: Kitchen
кухня.desc: Handles temperature swings near the stove if not right on the heat source.

лікувальний.label: Medicinal
лікувальний.desc: Aloe gel soothes skin — safe when harvested correctly.

безпечний для тварин.label: Pet-friendly
безпечний для тварин.desc: Non-toxic for cats and dogs — fine at pet height.

дитяча.label: Kids' room
дитяча.desc: Soft leaves, no sharp spines — safe pick for a child's room.

в'юнок.label: Vining
в'юнок.desc: Climbs a support or trails from a shelf — trim to encourage bushiness.

полиця.label: Shelf plant
полиця.desc: Compact — saves floor space, groups well with other plants.

патерн.label: Patterned
патерн.desc: Contrasting leaf pattern — striking even without flowers.

вологість.label: Humidity
вологість.desc: Needs 60%+ or a pebble tray — mist in winter if air is dry.

підвіконня.label: Windowsill
підвіконня.desc: Compact size — east or west window is usually enough.
